title: The inference settings
description: Fixed here, not chosen per experiment, for exactly the reason balance_covariates.yaml is: an alpha chosen per experiment is a degree of freedom, and anything that can be chosen after the fact will be chosen after the fact. Every entry is a {value, source} pair — a bare number here would be the 'value without a source' the contract layer exists to refuse, and a Decimal constant in a .py file is the same thing wearing a different extension. Nothing in this file is law; every source is a scenario_assumption, and saying so is the point of the split.

alpha.description: The declared false-positive rate. Claim 2 is stated against THIS number, so it is declared before the harness runs and never after.

target_power.description: The power the feasibility check sizes for. It decides whether a design may exist; it decides nothing at readout, where the realised variance does.

quantiles.description: Standard normal quantiles, written out because holdout.core may not import a statistics library. Both are recomputed independently in tests/contracts/test_inference.py — a boundary that has to be known is computed twice.

balance_tolerance_smd.description: The largest standardised mean difference between arms, on any declared balance covariate, that the readout's balance check will admit. Judged at exactly one moment since v2: assignment is stratified, so the balance lives in the restriction and the tolerance governs the readout alone.

exposure_min_pct.description: The share of assigned treated units that must actually have been exposed before any number may be stated.

holdout_share_pct.description: The share of the admissible roster held back as control. Strictly between 0 and 100: a holdout of nothing is not a holdout, and a holdout of everything leaves no treatment arm.

neighbour_radius_m.description: Two stores closer together than this are assumed to share shoppers. The pairs are supplied to the engine, which never computes a distance.

permutation_draws.description: How many candidate assignments the reference set holds. (1 + hits) / (1 + B) is exact at any B, so B buys resolution, not validity.

max_assignment_attempts.description: How many candidate indices the permutation reference set may scan. A budget rather than an unbounded loop; since v2 it budgets the reference-set scan, because the stratified draw screens nothing.

carryover.description: Declared facts about grocery retail, and the mitigations declared absent. The interference table over the four units of randomisation is DERIVED from this block and is nowhere written out: a hard-coded table would pass every test while quietly being a second definition of a contract value. These are assumptions about the trade, not observations of anything in this repository — in particular not of what corpus/world/ generates, which would be the generator and the engine agreeing with each other.

reference_price_memory.description: Whether willingness to pay at a store carries the price last seen at that store. True is what refuses store_week while no washout is declared.

cross_price_substitution.description: Whether categories inside one store contain substitutes. True is what refuses store_category.

washout_weeks.description: A declared washout period at least as long as the reference price persists, or null where none is declared. Null is the honest value and it is not zero: zero would assert that no washout is needed, which is a different claim.
